sentences.text:
On The 8 th Of March, 2025
 Criminal Appeal No. 11111 of 2022
 Smt. Baby
 Versus
 Keshav Singh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri A.R.Shivhare, learned counsel for the appellant.
 Shri Ranjeet Khanvilkar, learned counsel for respondent.
 Order
Per, Justice Anand Pathak Appellant Smt. Baby is present in person and produced her Adhar- Card for verification of her identity.

2. The present criminal appeal under Section 378 (4) of Cr.P.C. has been preferred against the judgment of acquittal dated 27.08.2022 passed by learned JMFC, Gwalior in Criminal Case No.2400074/2014, whereby learned trial Court has acquitted the respondents for the offence under Section 498A of IPC and Section 4 of Dorwy Prohibition Act.
3. At the outset, Smt. Baby informs this Court that her counsel Shri A.R.Shivhare has no objection and has allowed her to appear before the Lok- Adalat for settlement of case.

4. Shri Mehmood Khan, Advocate who is present in the Courtroom NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-GWL:5426 2 CRA-11111-2022 and appears in another case vide CRR.No.5691/2018 in which parties are the same and this case is listed before another Bench today itself, verifies the identity of appellant Smt. Baby.
5. Appellant Smt. Baby seeks permission to withdraw this appeal as settlement has been reached between her and litigating respondents.
